text:
Mina: Quick RFC follow-up: ops/playbook for the deprecation-coordinator. Wanted to capture billing, gating, SDK nudges, and emergency rollback flows. Posting draft notes here for comments.
Luca: SGTM. Can you list the key failure modes you worried about?
Mina: Short list: (1) coordinator control-plane partition -> can't create sidecars, (2) runaway sidecar count -> memory/FD pressure on edge pool, (3) shim-induced 5xxs or model regressions, (4) billing disputes when tenants get billed for coordinator resources unexpectedly.
Ben: For (1) we should design control-plane as eventually consistent and fail-open: if coordinator unreachable, edge should default to native v2 routes. No hard-blocks.
Priya: Agree. Also add a fast circuit-breaker: if coordinator can't reconcile route for >30s for a tenant, mark the tenant as "shim-disabled" and send a high-priority alert.
Mina: Good. For (2) propose soft quotas + auto-throttle: each org gets N sidecars per region by default; above that we place new tenants in a staged queue and notify Customer Success. We should also expose a metric: sidecars_per_org and sidecar_spike_rate.
Luca: How do we surface billing? If sidecars are ephemeral but add infra cost, we should bill only when sidecar is active and prorate per-minute. Also include an "opt-out of paid-shim" flag.
Ben: Billing math: charge = sum_over_sidecars(duration_minutes * sidecar_rate) + small config fee. Need to show clear invoice line items and a deprecation credit if we actively prevented outage during migration.
Priya: UX: show a "Migration Cost Estimate" page in Console before enabling shim for an org: estimated cost, days remaining in grace window, and migration checklist.
Mina: SDK nudges: when we detect v1-style auth/header usage from telemetry, we send an SDK popup (via SDK telemetry hook) with a one-click upgrade that replaces header munging with canonical SDK method.
Luca: How do we detect SDK presence? Many customers use homegrown clients.
Mina: Heuristic: combination of user-agent header prefixes + known SDK telemetry. Fallback: static scan tool we offer as opt-in. Don't auto-scan.
Ben: Security: sidecars will touch PII in requests. For hosted mode, ensure sidecars are in isolated namespaces and logs redacted. For private deployments, mandate sidecars run inside customer network or air-gapped clusters.
Priya: Add to checklist: KMS integration for any token transformations, RBAC roles for who can enable shim per-org, and audit logs with reason codes.
Mina: Rollback story: two-tier rollback -> (A) soft rollback: coordinator flips routing to native v2 (no tenant disruption) and disables sidecar creation for cohort; (B) hard rollback: coordinator strips routes and returns 410+help link after X days. Include automated Slack alert + runbook link.
Luca: For regressions we should capture request/response pairs and a diff-summary. But storing full payloads is sensitive. Suggest storing hashes + limited sample set (configurable retention).
Ben: Also add a regression scoring function: combine schema diffs, model answer divergence (BLEU/emd cosine on embeddings), and increased error-rate. If score > threshold -> auto-pause rollout.
Priya: Who owns the triage on pause? On-call SRE + product CS triage channel. Coordinator should create a paged incident with core metadata and sample diffs.
Mina: Ops automation ideas: 1) auto-open migration ticket with suggested code snippets, 2) automated PR builder that patches common header patterns in repos (opt-in), 3) scheduled nudges (email + Console) with migration progress metrics.
Luca: On PR builder: must be opt-in and sign commits with a service account. Also include a preview link to test in staging.
Priya: Metrics to emit: shim_enabled_tenants, shim_active_sidecars, shim_error_rate, shim_latency_delta_{p50,p95}, shim_shadow_regression_rate, shim_billing_minutes. Make them tenant-tagged and exportable to customer telemetry.
Ben: Operational limits: sidecar memory cap 256MB default, request concurrency limit 200, healthcheck interval 5s. These are tunable per-region.
Mina: Example deprecation header we discussed: `X-RW-Deprecation: v1->v2; notice=90d; shim=true; contact=ps@example.com`
Luca: Nice. Also add `X-RW-Deprecation-ID` for correlation.
infra-bot: deploybot: coordinator control-plane rollout scheduled tomorrow 03:30 UTC (canary 3 nodes).
Priya: Final ask: include a "sunset policy" document for legal/compliance: how long we keep shim logs, data residency for sidecar payloads, and SLA during migration window. I'll draft and attach to RFC.
Ben: One more: add a TTL+renewal flow for sidecars so customers can't silently keep shims forever. default_ttl=30d, renewal via Console or API.
Mina: OK I'll incorporate these and update the RFC with an ops playbook section. Will include minimal runbook steps and the emergency rollback commands. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/dep-coordinator-ops (WIP)
Luca: I'll add a short appendix on billing signals and invoicing language.
Priya: I'll draft the legal slide for the sunset policy.
Ben: I'll prototype the regression scorer (small python job) and wire a test harness to shadow traffic.
Mina: Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark RFC ready for review Friday.
Luca: No objections. :thumbsup:
Priya: +1
Ben: +1
Mina: Pinging @oncall and @solutions for awareness.
